reuse.why: Extends the existing shared isNonWorkingDay predicate and keeps using monthUtils.dayFromDate, so every caller (server app, budget template, shared next-date logic) picks up the rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the recurring-holiday match is a single extra clause in the one existing predicate.

placement.why: The holiday rule already lives in shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay, and the change is made there.

scope.why: Only the predicate, focused tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Simple and centralised, though day.slice(5) encodes the MM-DD format implicitly without a named helper or comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Change goes through the existing isNonWorkingDay in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic in the diff.
